version: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0

rules.title: Protection of stored cardholder data
rules.description: Cardholder data must be protected using strong encryption. Primary Account Numbers must never be stored in plaintext.
rules.required_clause: Cardholder data storage must use strong encryption and PAN must not be stored in plaintext.

rules.title: Restrict access to cardholder data by business need
rules.description: Access to cardholder data must be restricted to only those individuals whose job requires such access.
rules.required_clause: Access to cardholder data must follow least-privilege and need-to-know principles.

rules.title: Firewall and network segmentation
rules.description: A firewall must be installed and maintained to protect the cardholder data environment from untrusted networks.
rules.required_clause: Firewall configuration and network segmentation for cardholder data environment must be documented.

rules.title: Regular security testing and vulnerability scans
rules.description: All systems must be protected against known vulnerabilities through regular patching and security scanning.
rules.required_clause: Regular vulnerability scanning and penetration testing procedures must be documented.
